LESSON: GRAMMAR 4.3.1 VERBS AND TENSE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it necessary to indicate when an activity takes place?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify verbs in the simple present and simple past tense in a text
2. write sentences using the simple present tense
3. write sentences using the simple past tense

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify verbs in the simple present and simple past tense in a text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify verbs in the simple present and simple past tense in a text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. write sentences using the simple present tense
   In simple words: practise until you can write sentences using the simple present tense. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. write sentences using the simple past tense
   In simple words: practise until you can write sentences using the simple past tense. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense.
4. Show that you can: identify verbs in the simple present and simple past tense in a text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar 4.3.1 Verbs and Tense important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Construct and share sentences on a variety of issues, including leadership, using verbs in the appropriate tense,
2. Type the constructed sentences using a digital device,
3. Complete sentences using the correct tense of the given verbs,
4. Create and display charts showing words in their simple present and past tense,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify verbs in the simple present and simple past tense in a text
2. write sentences using the simple present tense
3. write sentences using the simple past tense

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
